# Strategy — nemo

> English canonical. Original Chinese discussion preserved in `tracking_zh.md` / `notes_zh.md` and issue #86.

## Current direction
**Hold the best score (0.85, `nemo-replay-v14`) to close** (deadline 2026-06-15 23:59 UTC). The faithful
replay of the public 0.86/0.87 recipe is our ceiling with current levers; two attempts to exceed it both
regressed (T7 merge 0.82, v15 cryptarithm synth 0.84). Remaining upside is low and high-risk.

## Open discussions
> All D1–D9 from issue #86 were **confirmed 2026-06-12** (see `tracking.md` Table 1). None are still open.
> The only live question is the optional last-roll variant below.

### D001: optional last-roll before the deadline
- status: open (user-decides)
- context: ~1.3 days left; v14=0.85 is banked; LB takes the max so downside is bounded.
- options: (a) hold 0.85; (b) half-dose cryptarithm-only synth (~800 ex, ~8%) to cut dilution.
- current leaning: **hold** — by the observed pattern, the variant is expected to land ≤0.85.
- evidence: issue #86 comment 4.
- follow-up: none unless the user requests the variant.

## Hypotheses
- **H1 (validated):** faithful public replay recipe (CCE + MoE tying + lm_head/Mamba LoRA + seq8192 +
  huikang corpus + replay-math) is the dominant lever (0.67→0.85). Evidence: T10 / issue #86 comment 2.
- **H2 (refuted):** category-weighted cryptarithm synth lifts total accuracy — single-category gains did
  not transfer; ~24% synth share slightly diluted other categories. Evidence: T11 / comment 4.
- **H3 (refuted):** weight-space SVD merge of strong+weak adapters beats the strongest member — dilution,
  not enhancement. Evidence: T7 / comment 3.
- **H4 (untested):** rejection-sampling self-distillation (v11) or Unsloth seq8192 (v12) could add headroom —
  never run (out of budget; v14 replay made them lower-priority).

## Rejected ideas
- v6: loss over prompt+padding (no response-only masking) → 0.44.
- ctx2k: seq2048 right-truncation destroyed the `\boxed{}` supervision tail → 0.42.
- T7: multi-adapter SVD merge (strong+weak) → 0.82; route **closed**.
- T11: ~24% cryptarithm synth dose → 0.84; de-prioritized (single-category ≠ total).

## Background analysis (zh source: work/00.nemo.md)
The competition is **hidden-rule generalization**, not memorization. Hardest categories: bit-manipulation
and equation/symbol transforms. Ideas A–F (rule-solver distillation, answer+CoT mixing, per-category
solvers/generators, bit-function enumeration, two-track equation handling, per-category local CV) are
recorded in `notes_zh.md`; most were superseded by the replay-recipe win. See also `insights.md`.
EOF

| 3. ROI 扩张 | **~90%** | v3 终态差分净船值**涵盖并超越**静态 ROI;556→686 的主要来源 | 开局序列优化(已试,齐射式失败) |

**§7 架构对照**(Harry 点名探索):StateParser ✅ / GeometryEngine ✅(85%) / **ThreatLedger ◻︎ 部分**(有 reserve+翻盘检测,缺统一时间轴→T9) / CandidateGenerator ✅(单步) / ActionEvaluator ✅(差分价值) / **Scheduler ◻︎**(有源预算扣减,缺跨动作冲突调度) / **MetaPolicy ◻︎**(仅 phase cap) / **Logger ❌**(→T9)。

<details>
<summary>🧬 Agent 演进与天梯结果(点开)</summary>

| 版本 | 思路 | 离线 | 天梯 | 结论 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1 | 拦截解算 + 精确占领数学 + ROI 扩张 | 88% vs starter | ~385→538 | 被替代 |
| v2 | “拿住才算”:在途上限 1.2× + 前线驻军(修复漏水扩张) | 92% vs starter | ~626 | 被替代 |
| v2.1 | 分阶段在途上限(2.0→1.0) | 200 局 ~打平 | **556** | 无真实增益 |
| **v3** | **Forecast**:bit-exact 前向模拟 + **终态差分净船值** + 模拟防御底线 | **91% vs v2.1** | **~686** | **自研最佳** |
| v3.1 | v3 + 模拟驱动防御增援 | 自博弈 62-66% vs v3 | suite 上 ≈ v3 | 仅自博弈增益;现 `main.py` |

核心资产:**bit-exact 前向模拟器**(对真引擎 3,672 个 planet-step 单元 0 误差)+ 守恒正确的终态差分价值函数 → 556→686,通杀弱档。
&lt;/details>

<details>
<summary>🧪 实验/杠杆跟踪表(点开)</summary>

| 杠杆 | 状态 | 在天梯预测套件上的结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 前向模拟差分价值(v3) | ✅ 保留 | 唯一大增益(556→686,通杀弱档) |
| 分阶段在途上限(v2.1) | ◻︎ 中性 | ~打平(无害,保留) |
| 防御增援(v3.1) | ◻︎ 仅自博弈 | 自博弈 +62%,套件上 **0 增益** |
| 合并兵力(闲置后方→前线) | ❌ 否决 | 从未胜过 v2.1;默认 OFF |
| safe_drain 出兵量 | ❌ 否决 | 倒退(无价值门控时过度摊薄扩张) |
| 多源**齐射**(同回合多源) | ❌ 无增益 | 对强档仍 0%;⚠️ 注:未做 ETA 对齐,**不等于否定 co-arrival**(→T8) |
| 开局序列规划器 | ❌ 无增益 | 出手多了(25 回合 9 次 vs 2 次)但胜率反降 |
| `PROJ_H` 视野扫描 | ❌ 无增益 | 更长反而更差(18→15.6%,30→3% vs evogen) |
| `OW_*` 参数随机搜索(T2-R1) | ❌ 无增益 | 300 局终测无配置胜 baseline;**教训:同配置批间波动 8-27%(24-60 局批)→ 一切对比需 ≥150 配对种子(±3.5pt)** |

**规律**:5 个移植自强档的单点杠杆全部失效 —— 强档赢在**一体化系统**(开局搜索 + 多波次 + supply + 模拟协同设计),不是单机制。
&lt;/details>

<details>
<summary>🔑 方法论结论(可复用)+ 强档研究(点开)</summary>

- **自博弈不预测天梯**:v3 离线赢 v2.1 91%,上天梯初期几乎同分(561 vs 556)。建了**强弱跨度公开 agent 套件**(random→starter→adilshamim→pub_tactical→evogen1093→multifocus→kuni05)后,离线胜率才与天梯对齐(我方 ~54% ≈ ~560-690;kuni05 89.6% ≈ ~1137)。**一切改动用套件门控,不用自博弈。**
- **并行竞技场**(`arena/pool.py`):~30-40× 提速,确定性可复现,2p+4p。引擎是纯 Python CPU 负载,**GPU 无用**,用 `--procs` 吃满核。
- **天梯确认为 1v1**(评分更新是配对 μ);4p 存在但不计分。
- **强档怎么赢**(研究了 kuni05 1240 + evogen 1093):两者都是前向模拟规划器,但做**协同多步规划**——①开局对占领*集合+顺序*做分支定界搜索;②多源汇兵同时到达;③梯度式 supply chain 后方→前线;+双方在途台账、每回合多波次。我们复刻了模拟+价值内核,但单步贪心复刻不了*系统*。
&lt;/details>

# Rules — Orbit Wars

> The installed engine is ground truth (`kaggle_environments/envs/orbit_wars/orbit_wars.py`); the web page is
> JS-rendered and unreadable by fetchers. Full mechanics + engine line refs are in [`README.md`](./README.md)
> ("Ground truth"). Facts with evidence; uncertain items marked **⚠ unverified**.

## Problem
Agent-vs-agent real-time strategy: over 500 steps on the `kaggle_environments` orbit_wars engine, capture and
hold planets to win. Engine supports 2-player and 4-player; the **scored ladder is 1v1**.

## Data
- No static dataset; games are generated by the engine (self-play + public-agent suite).
- A public episode dataset exists for replay mining: `kaggle/orbit-wars-episodes-2026-06-08` (~1.28 GB).

## Metric
- **skill-rating (μ) ladder**, μ0=600, **1v1**; win/loss drives a **pairwise μ update** (winner μ↑, loser μ↓,
  moved toward their mean). Margin does not matter — only win/loss.

## Submission format
- A **single-file agent** (`stdlib` + `kaggle_environments`) or a tar.gz package (e.g. adapted kuni05 with
  `orbit_lite/` + torch). Per-turn budget **1000 ms** (ours ~4 ms; crash-safe wrapper returns `[]` on error).
- **torch is usable on the eval side** (empirically: torch kuni05 scored ~1137/1151).

## Constraints
- **5 submissions/day**; the competition keeps only your **latest 2** active on the ladder.
- Engine is pure-Python, **CPU-bound — GPU does not help**; parallelize across cores.

## Deadline / schedule
- deadline **2026-06-23**; final eval ~2 weeks after. $50,000 Featured; competition id **138420**; ~4137 teams.

## External data / kernel / internet / GPU rules
- Public opponent agents are lifted from public notebooks (attributed); vendored opponents are gitignored and
  rebuilt via `arena/_reconstruct_pkg.py` / `arena/_extract_pub.py`.
- Compliance (issue #87): dual account = real registered teammates (harrysun2006 + firefly2006); same-competition
  second-account submission is **compliance-gated** in `submit.py` (`--i-confirm-compliance`) and needs human
  approval; never print/submit credentials.

## Unclear rules (⚠ unverified)
- Exact private/final-ladder μ computation; final-eval re-run details (confirm on the official page).
EOF

cat > strategy.md <<'EOF'
# Strategy — Orbit Wars

> English canonical. Original Chinese discussion preserved in `tracking_zh.md` / `notes_zh.md` and issue #87.
> Full version history, design studies and dead-ends are in [`README.md`](./README.md) (detailed log).

## Current direction
**D1 = C (low-cost continue):** replay mining + suite-gated parameter optimization, plus the v4 "Scheduler"
rewrite — rather than (A) wind down or (B) a full multi-week coordinated-planner rewrite. Accept the
**two-track split**: an attributed adapted public agent (kuni05) as the competitive ladder entry, and our own
from-scratch Forecast line developed in parallel. **Everything is gated on the ladder-predictive opponent
suite (`arena/suite_gate.py`), never self-play.**

## Open discussions (issue #87 — all confirmed 2026-06-12)
- **D1 direction = C** (low-cost continue). 
- **D2 submission slots:** submit locally-validated improvements; in the last 3 days freeze and re-submit the
  best 2 (latest-2 scored). 
- **D3 compute:** snorlax (RTX 4090 box, 24-core CPU) approved for large-sample sweeps (PR #89). 
- **D4 RL/distillation:** allowed on snorlax; only submit if it beats the incumbent through the T10 gate. 
- **D5 inline comment-marking:** allowed.

> No discussions are currently open; the live question is the last-3-days final-2 freeze (D2).

## Orbit-specific strategy categories
- **Rules / engine facts:** deterministic orbits; exact capture rule (`ships > garrison_at_arrival`); first-hit
  fleet consumption; same-tick same-owner combat summing. See `rules.md` / `README.md`.
- **Geometry / simulation:** bit-exact forward simulator (0 error vs engine over 3,672 planet-step cells) —
  the core asset enabling differential terminal net-ship value.
- **Baseline agent design:** intercept-aim + exact capture math + in-flight cap + frontier garrison (v1→v2.1).
- **Local arena / eval harness:** parallel arena (`arena/pool.py`, ~30–40×, deterministic, 2p+4p);
  paired-seed A/B; **ladder-predictive suite gate** (the "self-play doesn't predict the ladder" product).
- **1v1 strategy:** the scored mode; all tuning targets it.
- **4-player FFA:** not scored; kept only as a robustness test (player-count-agnostic design, per Harry).

## Hypotheses
- **H1 (validated):** bit-exact forward sim + conservation-correct **terminal differential net-ship value** is
  the one big lever (556→686). Evidence: README; issue #87 levers table.
- **H2 (refuted, ×7):** single mechanisms transplanted from the strong tier transfer — consolidation,
  safe_drain, defense-reinforce (self-play only), multi-source salvo, opening-planner, PROJ_H scan, OW_* random
  search all failed on the suite. Strong agents win as integrated systems. Evidence: issue #87.
- **H3 (open):** an integrated **hub-and-hammer scheduler (v4)** can convert the assembly machinery into wins —
  currently at parity with v3.2; the value function's frozen-opponent assumption (red-team FM3) is the bottleneck.
- **H4 (refuted):** behavior-cloning top players reproduces their play — T12 reached high imitation
  (recall@k 0.387) but **0% in arena** (BC distribution shift). Distillation de-prioritized.

## Rejected ideas
- Consolidation (long-range forwarding) ✗; safe_drain ✗; multi-source salvo (no ETA align) ✗; opening-sequence
  planner ✗; `PROJ_H` horizon scan ✗; OW_* random search ✗ (noise); OVERKILL multiplier ✗ (monotonic negative);
  T14 short-hop supply ✗ (mechanical forwarding); posture machine v1 ✗ (BRACE too often); T11 ledger constraint
  = no-op. co-arrival (T8): real but +3pt (evogen layer only) → default OFF (kept as `OW_COARRIVAL`).
EOF

cat > insights.md <<'EOF'
# Insights — Orbit Wars

## Competition-specific insights
- **Official `garrison+1` baseline is wrong for moving/producing targets** — neutrals are static but enemy
  planets grow by `production*travel_ticks`; lead the growth. Evidence: `README.md` (exact capture rule, engine refs).
- **Terminal (k=H) differential net-ship value is conservation-correct** — scoring over all k penalizes ships
  still in transit. This was the one big lever (556→686). Evidence: `README.md` (Forecast key bug).
- **少而重 > 多而小** — concentrated strikes (e.g. 27×78 ships) beat many small ones (117×19); ~56% of a top
  winner's launches are short-hop reinforcement (supply chain). Evidence: `EPISODES.md` #1 (Jake Will).
- **Top-6 are rule/search engines, no NN** — behavior cloning reproduces the *form* not the *system*
  (T12: recall@k 0.387 but 0% in arena). Evidence: `EPISODES.md` #2; issue #87 (T12 v2).
- **Strong tier wins as integrated systems** — 7 transplanted single-mechanism levers all failed on the suite.

## Potentially reusable insights

### INS-001: ladder-predictive offline suite (not self-play)
- type: rule
- confidence: high
- evidence: `README.md` / issue #87 (self-play 91% but ≈ on ladder; suite gate aligned)
- transfer scope: any competition with a hidden ladder / online eval
- status: validated (this competition); logged in `_shared/skill-candidates.md` (ladder-predictive-gate)

### INS-002: powered paired-seed A/B + bake gate (kill small-sample false positives)
- type: rule
- confidence: high
- evidence: issue #87 (batch noise 8–27%; ≥150 paired seeds ±3.5pt; +7pt bake gate caught a would-be regression)
- transfer scope: any stochastic-eval optimization
- status: validated

### INS-003: imitation/BC ≠ playing for integrated-system opponents
- type: anti-pattern
- confidence: medium
- evidence: issue #87 (T12 high imitation, 0% arena — distribution shift)
- transfer scope: imitation-learning on planning/agent tasks
- status: candidate

### INS-004: parallel arena — engine is CPU-bound, GPU useless
- type: fact
- confidence: high
- evidence: `arena/pool.py` (~30–40× across cores; deterministic)
- transfer scope: pure-Python simulation competitions
- status: validated
EOF
